Before your shifts start this evening, I wanted to update you on our restaurant's menu.
At our pizza tasting event last week, we introduced four new pizza toppings and asked attendees to vote for the one they like the best.
Take a look at the results I'm posting. best.
Take a look at the results I'm passing around now.
As you can see, figs received the most votes.
However, as you know, the prices of figs have gone up.
So we've decided to add the second most popular topping instead.
The new menus will be ready next week and for the time being we'll just write it on the specials board.
Please remember to let... diners know that it's available.

在今晚你的班次开始之前，我想向你更新一下我们餐厅的菜单。
在上周的比萨品尝活动中，我们介绍了四种新的比萨配料，并让出席者投票选出他们最喜欢的。
看看我正在发布的结果。最好的。
看看我现在传阅的结果。
正如你所看到的，无花果收到了最多的票。
然而，如你所知，无花果的价格上涨了。
所以我们决定添加第二受欢迎的配料代替。
新的菜单将在下周准备好，在此期间，我们只会在特价板上写下来。
请记住告诉...食客它是有供应的。
